summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Natalie Horler, a singer born in Bonn, Germany, to British parents who had moved there in 1980. It describes her family background, including a jazz musician father and a language-teacher mother, and her early childhood singing habits. The note is brief and covers only her origins and early life.
one_line: Biographical note on singer Natalie Horler, born in Bonn to British parents and raised in a musical family.
key_facts: Natalie Horler was born in Bonn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany.
Natalie Horler's parents were British and had moved to Germany in 1980.
Her father, David Horler, is a jazz musician.
Her mother, Christine, is a foreign languages teacher.
Natalie Horler grew up with 2 siblings.
Natalie Horler soon began singing jazz songs in her father's studio.
Natalie Horler also sang songs from Disney movies as a child.
The note describes Natalie Horler's early life and family background only.
